sections.title: Timing tower layout
sections.what: Confirms membership, gets ranked rows for every member, and draws the title, an explanation of each column, a provisional badge, the ranked list, and a footer explaining the form symbols.
sections.why: Likely reason: the explanation sits on the page so members can read the numbers.
sections.watch_out: The (you) label is added when the row id matches the viewer, so that match must stay correct.

summary: Shows the crew's timing tower: a ranking of members by Read Rating, a score for how well they call moments.
purpose: Lets crew members compare calibration, call counts and recent form, and see who gained or lost places since Monday.
why: The page text says bragging rights only, so the ranking is for fun and carries no prize. Reason otherwise not stated.
how: Checks membership, builds the member list, asks crewTower for ranked rows, and draws each row with rank, name (marked as you for the viewer), rating, Brier score, calls, form and change, plus a short explanation and a link to make a call.
inputs: Crew id, the signed-in user, member names and ids, and rows from crewTower.
outputs: A ranked list with a provisional badge and an explanation of the form symbols.
risks: Brier score is lower-is-better, which is easy to misread. The page is forced to load fresh on each visit, which may cost more work.
debug: If rows are missing, check the input to crewTower. If ranks look wrong, check the crewTower service. If the (you) marker is missing, check that row ids match the signed-in user id.
